parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group. The ID is generated by the system and is globally unique
parameters.help_zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the API operates. Valid values:

RELEASE: Production.
PRE: Staging.
TEST: Testing
parameters.help_zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

RELEASE: 线上

parameters.name: stage_name

AllowSignatureMethod.description_en:
The signature methods allowed for client requests to the API. Valid values:

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
AllowSignatureMethod.description_zh:
API的客户端请求签名方法，可选值：

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256

AuthType.description_en:
The security authentication type of the API. Valid values:

APP: Only authorized applications are allowed to call the API.
ANONYMOUS: Anonymous calls are allowed. If you select this value, take note of the following items:
     - Anyone who can obtain the API service information can call the API. API Gateway does not authenticate the callers and does not support user-specific throttling. If you make the API public, configure API-specific throttling
AuthType.description_zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

APP：只允许已授权的APP调用
ANONYMOUS：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
     - 任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制

DisableInternet.description_en:
If you set DisableInternet to true, the API can be called only over the internal network.
If you set DisableInternet to false, no restrictions are imposed on API calls.

When you modify an API, if you do not specify this parameter, the original value is retained
DisableInternet.description_zh:
设置DisableInternet为true, 仅支持内网调用API。
设置DisableInternet为false, 则不限制调用。

修改API时，不设置则不修改原来的取值

FailResultSample.description_en: The sample error response returned by the backend service
FailResultSample.description_zh: 后端服务失败返回应答的示例

ForceNonceCheck.description_en:
If you set ForceNonceCheck to true, the system forcibly checks the X-Ca-Nonce parameter in requests. This parameter is a unique identifier for a request and is typically a UUID. After API Gateway receives this parameter, it verifies the validity of the parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This effectively prevents replay attacks on the API.

If you set ForceNonceCheck to false, the system does not check the parameter. Default value when you create an API: false
ForceNonceCheck.description_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。

设置ForceNonceCheck为false，则不检查。创建API时默认为false

GroupName.description_en: The name of the API group

OpenIdConnectConfig.description_en: The configuration items for OpenID Connect authentication of third-party accounts
OpenIdConnectConfig.description_zh: 第三方账号认证OpenID Connect相关配置项

IdTokenParamName.description_en: The name of the parameter that corresponds to the token

OpenIdApiType.description_en:
The OpenID Connect mode. Valid values:

IDTOKEN: Obtains the authorization API and issues a token. If you select this value, the PublicKeyId and PublicKey parameters are required.
BUSINESS: The business API for token verification. If you select this value, the IdTokenParamName parameter is required
OpenIdApiType.description_zh:
OpenID Connect模式，目前可以取值：

IDTOKEN：获取授权API，颁发Token，当设置此项时，参数PublicKeyId和PublicKey为必传。
BUSINESS：业务API，Token验证，当设置此项时，参数IdTokenParamName为必传

PublicKey.description_en: The public key of the API

PublicKeyId.description_en: The ID of the public key

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the group

RequestConfig.description_en:
The configuration items for API requests sent from the consumer to API Gateway.

For more information, see [RequestConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43985.html）
RequestConfig.description_zh:
Consumer向网关发送API请求的相关配置项。

更多信息，请参见[RequestConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43985.html）

BodyFormat.description_en:
This parameter takes effect only when RequestMode is set to MAPPING.

For POST or PUT requests, this parameter specifies the method used to pass data to the server. Valid values: FORM and STREAM. FORM indicates the form format (key-value pairs), and STREAM indicates the byte stream format
BodyFormat.description_zh:
当RequestMode值为MAPPING时有效。

POST/PUT请求时，表示数据以何种方式传递给服务器，取值为：FORM、STREAM，分别表示表单形式(k-v对应)、字节流形式

PostBodyDescription.description_en: The description of the request body

RequestHttpMethod.description_en: The HTTP method. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS

RequestMode.description_en:
The request mode for input parameters. Valid values:

MAPPING: Maps input parameters and filters out unknown parameters.

PASSTHROUGH: Passes through input parameters.

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH: Maps input parameters and passes through unknown parameters
RequestMode.description_zh:
入参请求的模式，取值为：

MAPPING：入参映射（过滤未知参数）

PASSTHROUGH：入参透传

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH：入参映射（透传未知参数）

RequestPath.description_en: The API path. For example, if the full URL of the API is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, the path is `/object/add`
RequestPath.description_zh: API path，比如API的完全地址为`http://api.a.com：8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，path是指`/object/add`这一部分

RequestProtocol.description_en: The protocol types supported by the API. You can select multiple protocol types and separate them with commas (,), such as "HTTP,HTTPS". Valid values: HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket
RequestProtocol.description_zh: API 支持的协议类型，可以多选，多选情况下以英文逗号隔开，如："HTTP,HTTPS"，取值为：HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket

ResultBodyModel.description_en: The response body model of the API

ResultSample.description_en: The sample response returned by the backend service
ResultSample.description_zh: 后端服务返回应答的示例

ResultType.description_en: The format of the response returned by the backend service. Valid values: JSON, TEXT, BINARY, XML, and HTML. Default value: JSON
ResultType.description_zh: 后端服务返回应答的格式，目前可以设置为：JSON、TEXT、BINARY、XML、HTML。默认为JSON

ServiceConfig.description_en:
The configuration items for API requests sent from API Gateway to the backend service.

For more information, see [ServiceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43987.html）
ServiceConfig.description_zh:
网关向后端服务发送API请求的相关配置项。

更多信息，请参见[ServiceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43987.html）

FunctionComputeConfig.description_en: The backend configuration items when the backend service is Function Compute
FunctionComputeConfig.description_zh: 后端为函数计算时的后端配置项

ContentTypeCatagory.description_en:
The policy for the value of the ContentType header when the backend service is an HTTP service. Valid values:

DEFAULT: Uses the default value of API Gateway.
CUSTOM: Uses a custom value.
CLIENT: Uses the ContentType header from the client request
ContentTypeCatagory.description_zh:
调用后端服务HTTP服务时，ContentType头的取值策略：

DEFAULT：使用API网关默认的值
CUSTOM：自定义
CLIENT：使用客户端上行的ContentType的头

ContentTypeValue.description_en: The value of the ContentType header when the backend service is an HTTP service and ContentTypeCatagory is set to DEFAULT or CUSTOM
ContentTypeValue.description_zh: 调用后端服务HTTP服务，ContentTypeCatagory的值为DEFAULT或者CUSTOM时，ContentType头的取值

FcBaseUrl.description_en: The root path of the Function Compute service

FcType.description_en: The type of the Function Compute service

FunctionName.description_en: The function name defined in Function Compute

OnlyBusinessPath.description_en: Specifies whether the backend service receives only the business path

Path.description_en: The path of the request for the API

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role that authorizes API Gateway to access Function Compute
RoleArn.description_zh: Ram授权给API网关访问函数计算的arn

ServiceName.description_en: The service name defined in Function Compute

Mock.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable Mock mode. Valid values:

TRUE: Enables Mock mode.
FALSE: Disables Mock mode
Mock.description_zh:
是否采取Mock模式，目前可以取值：

TRUE：启用Mock模式
FALSE：不启用Mock模式

MockResult.description_en: The result returned when Mock mode is enabled
MockResult.description_zh: 如果启用Mock模式，返回的结果

MockStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code returned in Mock mode

ServiceAddress.description_en: The address used to call the backend service. For example, if the full URL of the backend service is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, ServiceAddress is `http://api.a.com:8080`
ServiceAddress.description_zh: 调用后端服务地址，比如后端服务完全地址为`http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，ServiceAddress是指`http://api.a.com:8080`这一部分

ServiceHttpMethod.description_en: The HTTP method used to call the backend service. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS
ServiceHttpMethod.description_zh: 调用后端服务HTTP协议时的Method，取值为：GET、POST、DELETE、PUT、HEADER、TRACE、PATCH、CONNECT、OPTIONS

ServicePath.description_en: The path used to call the backend service. For example, if the full URL of the backend service is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, ServicePath is `/object/add`
ServicePath.description_zh: 调用后端服务path，比如后端服务完全地址为`http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，ServicePath是指`/object/add`这一部分

ServiceProtocol.description_en: The protocol type of the backend service. Only HTTP, HTTPS, and Function Compute are supported
ServiceProtocol.description_zh: 后端服务协议类型，目前只支持HTTP/HTTPS/FunctionCompute

ServiceTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for the backend service. Unit: milliseconds
ServiceTimeout.description_zh: 后端服务超时时间，单位：毫秒

ServiceVpcEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the VPC channel. Valid values:

TRUE: Enables the VPC channel. You must add VPC authorization before you can enable the VPC channel.
FALSE: Disables the VPC channel
ServiceVpcEnable.description_zh:
是否启用VPC通道，目前可以取值：

TRUE：启用VPC通道，必须先添加VPC授权成功后才能启用
FALSE：不启用VPC通

VpcConfig.description_en: The configuration items for the VPC channel

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID (ECS or load balancing) in the VPC
InstanceId.description_zh: 专用网络中的实例ID（Ecs/负载均衡）

Name.description_en: The name of the VPC authorization

Port.description_en: The port number of the instance

StageName.description_en:
The environment in which the API operates. Valid values:

RELEASE: Production.
PRE: Staging.
TEST: Testing
StageName.description_zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

RELEASE: 线上
PRE: 预发
TEST: 测试

Visibility.description_en:
Specifies whether the API is public. Valid values:

PUBLIC: The API is public. If you select this value, the definition of the API in the production environment is visible on the "Discover APIs" page in the console of all users.
PRIVATE: The API is private. If you select this value, the API is not listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace when the API group is listed
Visibility.description_zh:
API是否公开，可以取值：

PUBLIC：公开，如选择此类型，该API的线上环境定义，会在所有用户的控制台“发现API”页面可见。
PRIVATE：不公开，如选择此类型，当该组API在云市场上架时，私有类型的API不会上架
